title: A Undertow for the Glasshouse
author: Paloma Reyes
blurb: Yara Pemberton, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
